function.arguments: {"sql":"SELECT S.Fname FROM Student S JOIN Has_Pet HP ON S.StuID=HP.StuID JOIN Pets P ON HP.PetID=P.PetID WHERE P.PetType IN ('cat','dog') GROUP BY S.StuID, S.Fname HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN P.PetType='cat' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)\u003e0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN P.PetType='dog' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)\u003e0;"}
function.name: run_sql
